# Approved commit author, committer, and tagger identities for this repository.
#
# The privacy gate (scripts/privacy-gate.ts) fails closed on any author,
# committer, or annotated-tag tagger email not listed here. Each entry names
# its justification; a new entry must add one.
#
# History note (2026-08-21): the coordinated rewrite executed under
# maintainer approval removed codex@local and all /home/<user> host paths from
# every reachable commit and tag. Reintroducing a machine-local identity is a
# gate failure by design.

# The deliberate public authoring identity of the maintainer. Retained by an
# explicit maintainer decision reaffirmed 2026-07-21 (see the pm-rust fleet
# reference allowlist); it is intentional public identity metadata, not leaked
# personal data.
